description: Dockerfile line 'COPY JMAP/ ./JMAP/' and the CI workflow step 'Checkout JMAP crates' both assume the JMAP sibling repo is checked out at exactly ../JMAP relative to the stoa repo, and that Cargo.toml path deps use ../../../JMAP/... . This is documented but fragile: a developer who builds from a different layout will get a confusing cargo resolution error with no useful diagnostic. The docker.yml workflow correctly sets this up, but a local build from within stoa/ without the sibling will fail silently. Document the required layout in Dockerfile comments and add a RUN test -d /build/JMAP guard.
title: docker: COPY JMAP crates hardcodes path layout assumption; breaks without JMAP sibling repo
